label: Yang pole
description: An axis-in-domain names which of its tension's two poles is yang in that domain. Endpoints: axis-in-domain -> pole. Exactly one per axis, and the pole is one its tension contains. Polarity exists only here: the same pole may be yang on one domain's axis and yin on a narrower one's.
canonicalDirection: source is the axis-in-domain; target is the yang pole
